part_bones._look_note: M2 AN1 commit 6: the bones of the parts data/art_soldier.json soldier.parts_add adds (the neck guard rides the Neck so it covers the gap between helmet and gorget when the chest leans; the shoulder bands ride the Chest like the pauldrons).

_bones_add_note: M2 AN2 item 1: bones the Blender-built soldier (assets/generated/characters/soldier.glb, tools/blender/build_soldier.py) adds after data/anim.json's 17, in this order. SoldierRig.build appends them to the runtime skeleton and the Blender script builds its armature from the same rows (tools/blender/soldier_data.py), so both agree. pivot offset: the named part's at plus offset_m (Godot metres), so moving the boot or glove part moves them too. Toes at the ball of the foot, Fingers one curl bone per hand at the knuckles, Prop at the right grip for held objects (nothing is skinned to it). Every rest basis is identity. Presentation only.

upper_body._reload_note: M2 AN1 commit 4: staged reload. reload_key_fractions are fractions of WeaponDef.reload_s; per key the left hand's offset from its foregrip target (aim, magazine, magazine out and down, belt pouch, new magazine seated, charging handle, back on the foregrip), the right hand's cant of the rifle (degrees about the barrel) and the chest's lean in (degrees, forward = negative). fire_*_deg: the per-shot kick through spine, chest and shoulders (they replace anim.json's smaller values; reload_hand_offset_m and reload_key_weights there are no longer read).

reload_keyed._todo: OQ-ANIM-RELOAD (M2 AN3): the Blender-keyed rifle reload per gun (tools/blender/build_soldier_rifle.py -> assets/generated/characters/soldier_rifle.glb, slots reload_<gun> in data/anim_sources.json; SoldierModel plays it before the code-built reload). Same stage times (reload_key_fractions), rifle cant (reload_cant_deg) and chest lean (reload_chest_deg) as the code-built clip, but every left-hand key is a point ON the shown gun (or on the belt), so the hand rides the canted gun and starts and ends on that gun's foregrip (no jump when the reload starts, no snap when the left-hand IK takes the hand back). left: per key, at = foregrip (soldier.gun.weapons.<gun>.foregrip_m), cell (the magazine: data/art_soldier.json weapons.<gun>.cell.at), charge (the charging handle: weapons.<gun>.charge.at) or pouch (pouch_m, skeleton metres, the belt pouch; it stays with the hips while the chest leans); off_m: metres from that point in the gun's frame (barrel -Z, top +Y) or the body's for the pouch; hand_deg: the left hand's turn in the chest frame (Euler YXZ degrees); then_m: after the key the hand moves through this extra offset and back over the first half of the next stage (the magazine shoved home, the charging handle run). authored_frames: the clip's length in 1/30 s frames (every key fraction lands on a frame); the runtime scales it to WeaponDef.reload_s (ClipLibrary.fit). snap_max_m: the largest one-frame left-hand move allowed when the reload ends and the IK takes the hand back (tests/test_soldier_rifle_glb.gd). Every number is a presentation trial, not a design value.

gait._todo: OQ-ANIM-FOOTSLIDE (M2 AN1 commit 4): third-person gait from the Quaternius UAL clips retargeted onto the soldier (scripts/visual/soldier_clips.gd, soldier_gait.gd). foot_slide_max_m is the placeholder limit of the stance foot's world drift during one ground contact (tests/test_soldier_footslide.gd), at the normal move speed, sprint and the downed speed; contact_height_m says when a foot counts as down. walk_slow_blend places the slow walk on the locomotion blend (move speed = 1). Strafe: the hips turn toward the motion up to hip_yaw_max_deg, the spine takes back spine_share of it; back_hysteresis_deg keeps the back-half switch from flickering. spine_follow scales the library spine motion under the aimed chest; chest_upright keeps that share of the aimed chest's own orientation. The helmet stays locked on the head hitbox (Neck and Head keep the aimed layer's rest), so the pelvis keeps only hips_bob_scale of a clip's dip and the legs are re-solved to keep the clip's feet, never stretched past leg_reach of their length and never below the rest foot height minus foot_floor_slack_m; the helmet may sink with the chest by up to neck_drop_max_m (the crest keeps the helmet's box around the hitbox's). upper_keeps_lower: bones the aimed layer and the reload leave to the library. hit: the flinch's bones, fades and rotation scale; head_drop picks the head clip for a shield+health drop at least that big (no hit zone reaches the victim's visuals). air: off the floor this long with this vertical speed shows the airborne loop. Every number is a presentation trial, not a design value.
gait._cycle_scale_note: M2 AN1 commit 6: a per-slot factor on the measured cycle_m (SoldierAnimation.build). The longer legs of data/art_soldier.json soldier.part_overrides lengthen the sprint's raw stride more than the re-solved, hip-locked legs show it; this corrects the playback rate, not the foot_slide_max_m limit. M2 AN2 item 2: 1 for every slot (was run_fwd 0.95, walk_slow 1.05): the Blender clips keep each planted foot within leg reach (tools/blender/build_soldier_clips.py), so the re-solve keeps the clip's feet and the measured cycle is the played one.

head._todo: OQ-ANIM-HEAD (M2 AN3): the body follows the head (the bobblehead fix). The helmet stays on the head hitbox; the torso is brought under it and the neck carries the chest's turn. SoldierGait: the library Hips swing (pitch/roll, never the yaw) keeps hips_keep of itself (cover_crouch_hips_keep in the crouched cover hug), then the Spine turns by at most torso_reach_max_deg so the chest top points at the pinned neck (the chest keeps its aimed orientation) and the chest rises along the spine by at most torso_stretch_max_m where it still hangs below the neck; neck_drop_max_m and leg_reach replace gait.neck_drop_max_m (0.1) and gait.leg_reach (0.97), the legacy values. SoldierNeck (the last modifier; it fades out while downed or reviving, whose poses carry the neck already): the Neck points from the chest top to the helmet centre and takes neck_follow of the chest's yaw, never more than neck_max_deg [pitch, yaw, roll] from the chest (exceptions.cover_crouch while crouched in cover) and never tilted more than neck_tilt_max_deg from upright outside the fall, landing and crouched hug (the neck and neck guard keep their clearance under the head hitbox, tests/test_soldier_model.gd; about 10 degrees is where the guard's box reaches it), low-passed with neck_smooth_s (1 - exp(-dt / tau), no spring) and at most neck_max_rate_dps, turned about the head hitbox centre so the helmet never leaves it; the Head keeps its own turn but stays within head_max_deg of the chest. SoldierModel: the locomotion blend moves at most blend_max_rate (blend units per second) per frame and is 0 while falling. CoverAnim: cover_mix and the hug's rest layer fade over cover_mix_fade_s / cover_rest_fade_s (cover_mix_fade_s must stay within data/cover.json animation.xfade_s). SoldierPose: fall_pivot_head turns the whole body (lean, fall, land) about the head hitbox centre (downed and revive keep the pelvis pivot); offset_moves_head: whether a pose's body_offset_m moves the head too. limits: what tests/test_soldier_head_motion.gd asserts. SoldierRig.head_legacy = true (tools: --legacy-head) skips this whole block (the pre-AN3 behaviour). Every number is a presentation trial, not a design value.
head._free_crouch_note: M2 AN3 stage C, M2 FIX1: the free crouch (H1c, out of cover). SoldierModel shows only the free crouch's own share, Pawn.free_crouch_amount times (1 - the cover layer's weight); CoverAnim shows the cover crouch (one owner each, the helmet lowered once). The lower body blends to the library crouch (cover_crouch_idle / cover_crouch_move, idle to moving over move_full_mps of ground speed). The neck pin drops share x nominal_head_drop_m, the Head node's drop at free crouch 1 (measured M2 FIX1: standing Head rest 1.75 - cover.json crouch_head_y_m 0.85 = 0.90 m; AN3 had assumed 0.55), and the pelvis's lift target drops hips_drop_per_head of it (the cover crouch: hips 0.36 m under a 0.85 m head, 0.6 / 0.9).
head._exceptions_note: M2 AN3 review fix: cover_crouch.neck_chest_rate_max_dps (750, only tests/test_soldier_head_motion.gd reads it) replaces limits.neck_chest_rate_max_dps (650) for the crouched LOW-cover hug and its transitions. Measured (the test, the real CoverController ramping crouch_amount): the keyed hunched hug holds the chest about 88 deg from the neck (inside neck_max_deg here), and the rise over the wall sweeps about 82 deg of it in cover.json aim_out_s (0.12 s, gameplay, not this file's): 681 deg/s on average, 710 at the peak, of which the chest's own turn is about 560 and the rest the neck turning the other way to stay on the chest top (the gap stays at or under 0.069 m). Under 650 it would need a slower rise (aim_out_s), a less hunched keyed hug, or a neck that lags its chest top (a larger gap): none is a head-block number. The low-cover entry (crouch_blend_s 0.2 s) peaks at 694.
head._limits_note: M2 AN3 review: neck_chest_max_deg (32) and gap_max_m (0.09) were fitted to the result measured after the fix, not set beforehand: the fall reaches 30.99 deg and 0.0843 m (tests/test_soldier_head_motion.gd, runs/M2AN3 gate_suite2.log), about 1 deg and 6 mm under them, so a small drift in the fall pose fails the test. The other upright states sit well under both.

crawl._todo: OQ-ANIM (M2 AN1 commit 4): the code-built downed knee-crawl (scripts/visual/soldier_crawl.gd; the UAL has no crawl). step_m: how far a planted knee travels under the body per stance (a cycle covers 2 x step_m of ground); lift_m: swing knee lift; knee_height_m: the knee joint's height when it rests on the ground; pelvis_pitch_deg: forward lean of the pelvis (its roll is derived: the swing side hikes until its knee clears the ground); body_back_m: hips offset along +Z; shin_rise_deg: shins laid back on the ground; foot_point_deg: toes pointed (about the foot's X); settle_cycles_s: how fast the cycle settles to both knees down when the pawn stops. Presentation trials, not design values.
crawl._arms_note: The arm opposite the advancing knee reaches forward, with its elbow following the shoulder. The upper-body motion fades out at rest. Presentation trial.

keyed._todo: OQ-ANIM (M2 AN2 items 3 and 5): hand-keyed clips authored in Blender on the soldier rig (tools/blender/build_soldier_keyed.py -> assets/generated/characters/soldier_keyed.glb; slots in data/anim_sources.json under 'blender'). Read by the Blender script and the runtime alike. ladder: cycle_m is how far the body climbs in one cycle of ladder_up (each hand and foot moves up cycle_m / rung_m rungs per step); the runtime plays ladder_up / ladder_down at the time given by the feet's height on the ladder (fposmod(height / cycle_m, 1)), so hands and feet never slide on the rungs and a held stick holds the pose; rung_m is the rung spacing the clip is authored on (data/props.json ladder look: 0.3 m on its 4.2 m look); climb_offset_m mirrors props.json ladder climb_offset_m (where the rungs are in front of the climber); blend_s fades the climb in and out; dir_mps is the vertical speed that picks up or down; top_catchup_m is the nominal top-step move (old feet minus new feet in the model frame: +y up, +z back toward the ladder) the ladder_top clip is authored with, the runtime adds the difference to the real move and fades it out over top_catchup_s. actions: fade_s in and out of a one-shot; full_body clips own every bone, the others only upper_bones; hide_gun: the gun is slung (hidden) while that clip shows at half weight or more. cover: crouch_hips_y_m is the pelvis height the crouched cover clips are authored at (rest 0.96 - (standing capsule 1.6 - cover.json crouch_height_m)); the runtime keeps CoverAnim's own heights. Presentation trials, not design values.
